P1.source: Reread Algorithms1-2 and visually inspected source p.20, Section4.2 core generator and corresponding current DDIM/DDPM/test helper functions.

independent_argument.derivation: For independent unit Gaussian x0 and epsilon, conditional covariance Cov(epsilon,x_n)=sqrt(1-alpha_bar_n) and Var(x_n)=1, so the square-loss optimum is sqrt(1-alpha_bar_n)*x_n. Substitution into line6 gives sqrt(alpha_bar_n)*x_n. Thus the output variance is product_n alpha_bar_n=.99^(100*101/2), rather than the invariant forward marginal1. The exact stationary Gaussian reverse kernel sqrt(alpha_n)*x_n+sqrt(1-alpha_n)*z has variance1.

P1.alternative_and_dependency: Current ddim_time187-194 has x0 plus previous-level, direction and stochastic terms; ddpm_time226-256/714-762 has posterior and noise. Main test calls80,127,254,333 select DDPM; the plot helper200 selects DDIM. Neither path is the literal printed loop. Conditioning fixed and uninformative is an admissible diagnostic for a general epsilon sampler, not a simulation of trained networks or a theorem that every BRIDGE distribution collapses.
P1.severity_and_repair: Corrected to Major for the invalid published core inference specification. Reverse diffusion is necessary for the claimed generation pipeline; an invalid core algorithm need not invalidate every empirical result to be Major. The available standard-code repair and uncertain historical impact narrow the allegation, not the established algorithm defect. Publish the actual schedule/reverse update and identify historical execution; the structural repair is checked but no author training was executed.

P2.source: Read AppendixG distributions pp.23-24, source Table1 p.7 and full metric code relevant functions. Corrected the initial report mistakenly identifying the twelve-domain table as Table2.

independent_argument.density_example: P=(.5,.5),Q=(1,0), equal binwidth.001: PMF L1=1; mean absolute density difference=(500+500)/2=500. Units and bin width matter.
independent_argument.tail_mechanism: Generated real-range density histogram normalizes only retained observations. A99% tail outside[0,1] therefore leaves the retained conditional distribution identical. Entropy normalizes its inputs again. MDD uses total generated count in its density denominator, so it does not share that renormalization.

P2.alternative_and_dependency: Large source Table1 MDD values can be explained by a density-distance interpretation rather than impossible probability values. Actual generated outliers and historical evaluation revision are unavailable; no ranking reversal or invalid whole empirical distribution is established.
P2.severity_and_repair: Minor scoped metric specification/estimator correction; document density formula/preprocessing/binning, retain overflow information and reevaluate original outputs to learn impact.

P3.source: Reread AppendixM p.27 describing1000 replacement resamples followed by a t-test. Independently derived the variance scaling and reran a standalone synthetic diagnostic, without importing author code.

independent_argument.reason: Conditional bootstrap replicate variance estimates sampling variability of the original statistic. Treating B replicate statistics as B new experimental units divides this variability by B again; B controls Monte Carlo error, not original information.

P3.alternative_and_dependency: A proper bootstrap tail/null test would not have this flaw, but is not the described ordinary t-test. Original Table14 statistics are not reconstructed. Direct SMAPE/MASE tests are separate. Generation quality and other task comparisons do not depend on this auxiliary significance procedure.
P3.severity_and_repair: Minor retained for the scoped downstream OWA significance claim; use paired original-series resampling with the full OWA normalization and a valid interval or null-calibrated test. Dependence/multiple comparisons need their own protocol.

scope_and_clarifications.source: Reread source Tables1,3,5; AppendixH candidate setup; AppendixA.2/A.4 future-window examples and core template/data synthesis discussion; current per-window fill function.
scope_and_clarifications.independent_argument: Table1 external baseline minima: BRIDGE wins MDD10/12 (exceptionsSolar,Air) andKL11/12 (Air). Table3 beats no-text JFTSD12/12 and both ablations11/12 (Rain .147 vs no-prototype .141). Table5 reductions computed directly from49.36->40.94,15.12->12.39,59.88->48.64,49.71->42.37 are17.0583%,18.0556%,18.7709%,14.7656%. Traffic/Pedestrian HE-Rank differences are2.8/1.1, not over3. A four-candidate ordinal-rank mean cannot be4.2, but the actual pool is not enumerated.
scope_and_clarifications.alternative_and_dependency: HE-Mixed adds3 distractors and must not be conflated with HE-Rank. Additional candidates or a score convention could explain4.2. Desired-target statistics are valid conditioning information for conditional generation; forecasting requires a prospective information cutoff. Static filling of window extrema/mean proves available data flow, not historical leakage or split contamination.
